 *
 * @param options The axis or The direction in which to shift existing cells.
 *   Defaults to the axis where the range's dimension is smaller (e.g., shifts down if the range is wider than it is tall).

 * @throws `Error` If the insertion would cause data to exceed the maximum sheet size.
 * @returns The current `ICellRange`.
 *
 * @remarks
 * By default the values will direction in whichever direction the selection shape is smaller.
 * For example a selection with a 5 column by 1 row will direction Down (rows).
 * Note - This will error if direction data will fall outsize of the max sheet size.
 */
